description: On the E-port recipe, change only the epoch count: 9 → 8.5 if the port clears 0.753 with at least 0.3 pp margin, otherwise 9 → 10. Everything else stays identical, so this measures the local accuracy-vs-time slope that sets how far epochs can be cut.
